name: Earth (planet view) V21
description: Earth on its own, increment 21 of 21. The continents are a dot map: one dot per cell of a 5-degree grid that is land on a real coastline map (Natural Earth 1:50m, sampled), so the coasts follow the real shapes. Dots are smaller and four times denser than V02 to V10. Deserts are rough boxes; sizes are rough, not to scale.
